data.description: JSE-listed mining companies publish quarterly and interim production reports via the SENS newsfeed. These often include references to planned maintenance stoppages, reduced production guidance, or shutdown windows.

data.signal_type: Stats SA Mining Production and Sales Release
data.description: Monthly report by Statistics South Africa covering mine-level production by commodity. Declines in specific commodities month-on-month indicate shutdowns or equipment failures.
data.monitoring_frequency: Monthly (released approx. 6 weeks after reference month)
data.lead_time: Lagging indicator; use for post-event analysis and future planning

data.signal_type: Mining Weekly and Engineering News Project Tracker
data.description: Trade press publishes planned shutdown schedules, plant upgrades, and capital project announcements for major operations.

data.signal_type: Mine Health and Safety Council (MHSC) Incident Reports
data.description: MHSC publishes reportable equipment failures, structural incidents, and Section 54/55 stoppages under the MHSA. Stoppages signal urgent repair and maintenance opportunities.

data.signal_type: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources (DMPR) Notices
data.description: DMPR issues Section 54 work stoppages following safety incidents; these force immediate maintenance and remediation work.
